title: DuPage County Historical Museum

services.name: Pop Up Exhibit
services.desc: August 15-November 14, 2026 Take a ride down memory lane on Route 66. This year the legendary “Mother Road” turns 100! Celebrate this golden anniversary along with other iconic firsts in DuPage County. Learn about the first 18-hole golf course, the first rails-to-trails conversion, the first public library, and the first shot fired at Gettysburg. In collaboration with local photographer, Bill North, Built to Last highlights DuPage County buildings that stand out for their unusual design or unexpected reuse. services.name: Mad Fore Plaid Mini Golf
services.desc: Join the Wheaton Public Library and the DuPage County Historical Museum for the 4th annual Mad Fore Plaid Mini Golf event. Get decked out in your favorite plaid and join us for 18 themed holes of wacky fun at Wheaton Public Library! Following the event will be a 19th Hole After Party at Ivy Restaurant in Wheaton. This 21+ event also includes 18 holes of mini golf, cash bar (one drink included with registration), appetizers, live entertainment and awards. All event proceeds benefit the Wheaton Public Library Endowment Fund of the DuPage Foundation and the DuPage County Historical Museum

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Choose a favorite theme whether you are looking for a charming tea party, an adventure with dinosaurs, or climbing aboard for a train-themed celebration, there’s a party experience to make every birthday extra special. Ten children (including the birthday child) are included in the party package. Additional children may be included at a cost of $10 per child (maximum 18). The staff will work with you to create a memorable experience. The Margaret Adams Dunton Hall located on the second floor offers space to accommodate up to 100 guests.
